title: The Quiet Channel
location: Salvari Camp and the cave galleries — wherever the squad makes camp
summary: A companion you saved at the last second carries something the program never finished. Not a traitor — a compromised channel. She offers you her knife, grip-first, and asks you to read the map she can't trust herself to read.
_hooks: The Carrier/mole arc as a mission (STORYLINE_EXPANSIONS (c)). It DRIVES THE EXISTING lena.json `carrier_confront` tree (node c0) and reads its REAL outcome flags — lena.cure_path / mole.weaponized / lena.final_choice — rather than inventing new ones (no duplicate tree authored). give-gated on mole.suspected (set by act2_the_root_remembers' whisper) + a <girl>.carrier flag (set silently by the host when a girl was rescued at InfectionStage::Critical — the existing timeline.h [0,90,60,30,0] stage model, NO new infection state). Three priced resolutions: cure (needs salvari.cure_known from act2_refugee_haven), double-agent (mole.weaponized → STORYLINE_EXPANSIONS (f3) final-whisper), knife (irreversible, with a last spare-at-the-edge off-ramp routing back to the cure path). The whole arc is MISSABLE — never-noticed routes to o_buried (a player learns the truth only in an ending slide). Generic over which girl carries (lena default; aria/keisha/emily.carrier accepted at the offer gate, each driving her own infected_lost pool).
_voice: Per the pack and SPICE_GUIDE: menace stays restrained. She offers the knife grip-first; the cost surfaces gently. No resolution is free, and declining to act is itself a (costed) choice. The objective text quotes her own conditions back, never narrates harm.

stages.objective: The drones drift wrong around her. A door opens she was never taught. Decide whether to say what you've noticed.
Confront her. Camp, quiet, no one else in earshot.
There's a way to purge a dormant strand — Salvari cure tech, the synthesis lab. Get it, and defend her while it runs.

args.text: It takes time. Time is when the hive tries to take her back.

stages.objective: You don't have the cure yet. Ally with the Salvari first; she'll hold until you do.

args.text: She'll wait. She's good at waiting; that's part of the problem.

stages.objective: Keep the tapped wire and feed it lies. It works — and the strand advances every time you use it. She set the toll herself; honor it.

args.text: You watch her sleep. Aria checks her at every hold. Those were her conditions, not yours.

stages.objective: She offered it. On camera, in your hand, irreversible. Nobody will make you. She won't even flinch.
You say nothing. The ambushes keep feeling unlucky. Some things you only learn at the very end, if at all.
The channel is closed, one way or another. What it cost is yours to carry.
